CustomField.description: Developer name of the email template the Send Start Link flow uses to invite someone to a new Form Submission that an admin created with a token already set. Leave blank to opt this template out: no invitation email is sent for its submissions.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Developer name of the email template for the start-form invitation an admin sends. Leave blank to opt out; no invitation email is sent for this template.
CustomField.label: Email Template Name (Start Form)
